about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the foundation module tool-handlers becomes the workspace package @purin-labs/tool-handlers in foundation/tool-handlers. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from versionsFrom. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs, and of a path that is no import; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again. package.typeCheck false: the package has no check:types script of its own. Its own files read the Env key CONNECTOR, which services/platform/src/actors/connector.ts (workers/platform) merges with declare module of @purin-labs/kernel/env, and through its dependencies the program lacks ORGANISATION, SESSION and CASE. The package alone gives 139 errors, 9 of them in its own files. The Worker program checks its files.
